sections.title: IV. Điền từ vào đoạn văn
sections.instruction: Chọn từ đúng cho mỗi chỗ trống.

items.title: Save water
items.passage: Water is very important (21) ___ all living things. We use water (22) ___ drinking, cooking and washing. But clean water is not unlimited, so we (23) ___ save water every day. For example, turn (24) ___ the tap when you brush your teeth. Take a short shower (25) ___ of a bath. If everyone helps, we (26) ___ have enough water in the future.

items.explain: Khoá vòi nước: turn off the tap.
Câu điều kiện loại 1: If… , we will…

sections.title: V. Đọc hiểu
sections.instruction: Đọc đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng.

items.title: Lisa's favourite season
items.passage: Lisa is twelve and she lives in Canada. In winter, it is very cold and there is a lot of snow, so Lisa and her friends go skiing and build snowmen. Her favourite season, however, is autumn. The leaves on the trees turn red, orange and yellow, and the weather is cool. Every October, Lisa's family drives to a farm to pick apples. They bring the apples home and her mother makes apple pies. Lisa says autumn is the season of colours and the best food.

items.prompt: Where does Lisa live?
What do Lisa and her friends do in winter?
options: They go skiing and build snowmen.

items.prompt: What is Lisa's favourite season?
What does Lisa's family do every October?
options: They pick apples on a farm.
items.explain: "drives to a farm to pick apples".

items.prompt: Which is NOT true?
options: It snows a lot in winter.
The leaves change colour in autumn.
items.explain: Mẹ của Lisa làm bánh táo, không phải bố.

items.prompt: The word "however" in the text shows ___.
items.explain: however: tuy nhiên (đối lập với ý mùa đông ở trên).
